Report Description12:07 GARDEN RIVER WATER FACILITY SUPERVISOR FIRST NATION CODY BOISSONIEAU 705-971-1210 TO SAC(HM) REPORTING ON BEHALF OF THE FIRST NATIONS REGARDING A SPILL IN A DITCH LOCATED ON 51 GREEN SKY STREET, GARDEN RIVER FIRST NATION. CALLER SAYS THEY GOT A REPORT FROM THE RESIDENT THAT LIVES AT THIS ADDRESS THAT THEY CAN SMELL GASOLINE IN THEIR HOME LAST FRIDAY. CALLER SAYS THEY CAME TO SITE TODAY AND HAD UNION GAS ATTEND. CALLER SAYS THERE WAS SOME GASOLINE OR SOME TYPE OF POLLUTANT FOUND IN THE SUMP CAUSING FOR THE ODOURS. CALLER SAYS UNION GAS FOUND THERE WERE LEL LEVELS PRESENT. CALLER SAYS THEY HAVE TEMPORARILY REROUTED THE SUMP TO OUTSIDE OF THE BUILDING TO AVOID ANY CONCERNS FOR THE RESIDENT. CALLER SAYS THEY HAD A LOT OF PRECIPITATION IN THE PAST BIT AND BELIEVE A SPILL THAT WAS IN THE DITCH WERE THE CAUSE OF THE SUMP BEING IMPACTED. CALLER SAYS THE DITCHES WATER LEVEL ROSE PAST THE SUMPS DISCHARGE PIPE AND WENT BACK INTO THE HOUSEHOLD CAUSING THE ODOURS AND SUMP IMPACTS. CALLER SAYS THEY BELIEVE THE SPILL IS LIKELY TO HAVE COME FROM A LARGE 5 BAY GARAGE BUILDING NEXT TO THE RESIDENCE. CALLER SAYS THERE IS A FD, EMP BUILDING AND MANY LARGE VEHICLES NEARBY. CALLER SAYS THERE ARE ALSO SNOW TRUCKS AND SUCH WITHIN THE AREA THAT ARE MAINTAINED. CALLER SAYS THEY CANNOT PINPOINT WHERE THE SPILL CAME FROM, BUT THERE IS EVIDENT SPILLAGE TO THE DITCH AREA AND HAS AN OIL/GASOLINE STAIN. CALLER SAYS THE FD WAS MADE AWARE AND SO BOOMS WERE PLACED IN THE DITCH, BUT NO CLEAN-UP HAS COMMENCED. CALLER SAYS THEY HAVE HAD THEIR ENVIRONMENTAL HEALTH OFFICER ATTEND SITE AND TAKE SAMPLES. CALLER SAYS THEY ARE LOOKING FOR RECOMMENDATIONS GOING FORWARD BY LOCAL MECP. CALLER SAYS THEY WILL PROVIDE WRITTEN PERMISSION TO ATTEND SITE AND GLADLY PROVIDE MECP ACCESS. CALLER SAYS LOCAL MECP SAULT STE MARIE IS ALREADY AWARE OF THE ISSUE, BUT THEY WERE ASKED TO CALL INTO SAC TO MAKE A REPORT. CALLER WAS INFORMED REPORT WILL BE SENT TO LOCAL MECP AND ECCC.

ON 02/09/2013 AT 1343 HOURS, CSX ENGINEER, REPORTED LOCOMOTIVE CSXT 8708 POWERING TRAIN N68806, LEAKED APPROXIMATELY THREE TO FOUR GALLONS OF LUBE OIL WITH A MIXTURE OF WATER ONTO THE TRACKS AT MP BA 75.5 ON THE METROPOLITAN SUBDIVISION. THIS IS LOCATED WITHIN THE BRUNSWICK YARD AT 100 SOUTH MAPLE AVENUE, IN BURNSWICK, MD. CSX HAZARDOUS DUTY MANAGER WAS CONFERENCED IN WITH CALLERS AND ADVISED ENVIRONMENTAL CONTRACTORS WOULD BE NOTIFIED. CSX ENGINEER ALSO ADVISED THAT THE ENGINE WAS SHUT DOWN AND LEAK WAS SECURED, AND THAT THE LOCOMOTIVE WAS BEING REMOVED FROM SERVICE. FREDERICK COUNTY EMERGENCY OPERATIONS CENTER WAS ALSO NOTIFIED. CSX HAZMAT MANAGER ADVISED HEPACO ENVIRONMENTAL CONTRACTORS WERE RESPONDING WITH A 1545 HOUR ETA. ***THIS IS A WEB REPORT***
